properties.name: Gunung Merapi
properties.note: Active stratovolcano; major 1822 eruption portended the Java War in local belief.

properties.name: Gunung Merbabu
properties.note: Massive stratovolcano directly north of Merapi.

properties.name: Gunung Sumbing
properties.note: Second highest peak in Central Java, guarding Kedu plain.

properties.name: Gunung Lawu
properties.note: Sacred boundary mountain between Surakarta and East Java.

properties.name: Gunung Slamet
properties.note: Highest peak in Central Java, towering over Banyumas and Tegal.

properties.name: Pegunungan Menoreh
properties.note: Limestone ridge sanctuary harboring Diponegoro and rebel strongholds.

properties.name: Gunung Ungaran
properties.note: Mountain fortress overlooking Semarang and Ambarawa.

properties.name: Gunung Cereme
properties.note: Highest summit in West Java near Cirebon.

properties.name: Dataran Tinggi Dieng
properties.note: Volcanic plateau and sacred antiquities site.

properties.name: Gunung Wilis
properties.note: Extinct volcanic complex separating Madiun and Kediri.

properties.name: Gunung Arjuno
properties.note: Prominent peak of East Java overlooking Malang.

properties.name: Gunung Raung
properties.note: Massive caldera volcano in the eastern salient of Java.
